narrative.opening: Three metrics, eight models, no simulator. Pick one and defend it.
narrative.why_these_three: mmd, dpp and viol are the columns almost every generative-design paper reports, because they are the columns you can afford.
narrative.habibi: Habibi et al., When Is it Actually Worth Learning Inverse Design? (J. Mech. Des. 148(6):061704, 2026) found kNN beats deconvolutional networks for topology-optimization warm-starting at limited data, once data-generation cost is counted. Two entries in your bank are exactly that comparison.
